preliminary_run.disposition: Retained unsuccessful preliminary run, not reclassified as skips. Started before the documented chmod -R go-w .github/coordinator precondition; tests were also expanded during that run. Superseded by the final consistent-precondition run. This does not certify historical failures at the prior writer environment.

findings.F1: Physical teardown readback required on initial completion/retry and repeated receipt. Drift or unavailable observation refuses. Successor receipt explicitly historical; no shared commands/mutations.
findings.F4: Exact child environment allowlist retains GitHub/Linear/transport exclusion and alias/unknown-key refusal; N1 corrects legitimate model credentials/configuration classification.
findings.F5: Environment and systemd credential paths share secret type, length and character validation.
findings.F2_F3: Journal hash/link/sequence/torn/custody refusals, forged-completion recovery, and named kills for all NV1–NV6; fixed durability oracle independent of crash-boundary enumeration.
findings.N1: Nine required adapter model credential/configuration names now survive the real fork boundary; positive delivery assertion and nine deletion mutation kills. B1 provisioning remains blocked.
findings.N2: Physical safety teardown effects replay despite DONE; observation and current-attempt success precede expiry timer retirement; no fallback retirement on failure. Corrected persistent-drift refusal test now demands transient-drift recovery via resume/revoke/expire. Broker/service restart cases and three genuine-assertion mutation kills.
